summary: Executed the follow-up that removes the last derived claim about the no-snapshot variant: whether an ordinary configuration entry repairs the empty configuration and closes the vote it allowed. The new harness (assurance_empty_config_repair_test.go, validated with 5 comparisons over 6 events on question 16929a65…-question-0) repeats the fixture, the feature-enabled restart and the outside-candidate probe — granted with zero configured servers, refused when the node holds {A,B,C} — then reconnects the node, has the leader append one ordinary configuration entry through AddVoter, and re-probes: the node's configuration comes back as {A,B,C,D} from that entry (still holding no snapshot store contents, so the AppendEntries configuration path is the only possible source) and the identical probe is refused again with the candidate outside the refilled configuration and no leader known. Both local runs reproduced that shape, including the honest wrinkle that the configuration change reports a leadership change while committing; validation confirmed the only effect is one experiment creation. The receipt will need interpretation on the next step, which the run's remaining time may not allow.
